newsitem.title: POLAND: Nine investors interested in Rafako stake.
newsitem.headline: Nine investors interested in Rafako stake.

text.p: Nine investors, foreign and domestic, are interested in a strategic stake in Polish industrial boilermaker Rafako SA, the firm's deputy president said on Friday.
"Nine domestic and foreign investors expressed initial interest in taking our shares," Antoni Szendzielorz told Reuters.
Last month, Rafako said it was looking for an investor from the sector to strengthen its position on the market. @

Szendzielorz said the company hoped to find and sign an agreement with the investor by the end of June. He declined to name the firms involved and said it had yet to be decided how large the stake would be.
The company earlier said the investor could take between 3.17 and 4.17 million of planned new shares, approved for trade by the Polish Securities Commission in February last year.
The issue was delayed because Rafako was not satisfied with the issue price of 14 zlotys, set through a book-building.
The book-building was carried out after the firm showed a net loss of 56.5 million zlotys in an audited 1995 report. @
Currently Rafako has 9.3 million shares outstanding.
Rafako's main shareholder is the Polish company Rafako Sp z o.o., which has 47.5 percent of shares in the firm.
